ideas.title: The Impact of Medicaid Funding on Low-Income Families
ideas.description: This story would investigate the effects of the Trump administration's withholding of Medicaid funds on low-income families and individuals.
questions: How many families will be affected by the withholding of Medicaid funds?
What are the potential long-term effects on healthcare for low-income individuals?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to highlight the human impact of policy decisions and shed light on the importance of Medicaid funding for low-income families.
